description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for offering a job to a candidate within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It extends an abstract class, includes API documentation annotations, and references external classes like WorkflowStateMachine.

classes.name: CandidateJobOfferingAPI
classes.description: API class that provides functionality to offer a job to a candidate, returning a specific workflow state indicating the action to be performed.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the constant representing the workflow state for offering a job to a candidate.
